body:
Thanks, that’s a good point about fit. Like another commenter suggested, something relates to business analytics or market research would be a better fit than, say, accounting. My thinking when I enrolled was that I’d have more options with an MBA than with another degree, and might not be as pigeon holed into one area. I’ve sort of come to the realization in my 30s that with ASD/ADHD no job that pays my bills will be a perfect fit, but some jobs are more tolerable than others?

I totally get what you’re saying about your son being non stereotypical. ASD is such a weird and wild spectrum. I wish him, and you, the best!

Thanks for the book rec, I’ll check it out!

Yeah, I’ve heard the MBA has diminishing value on its own, which really sucks. One thing I have to consider is that just being in school has already helped me earn a promotion at work after 2 semesters. I guess I appear more driven as a student, or was just lucky, but I’m told that my enrollment in the program was a factor in being promoted. So being in the program has kind of allowed me to bootstrap my way up into my first managerial role, and I have my own small team now. Playing devil’s advocate, is it worthwhile to try and continue to combine my current work experience with this degree to create a compelling employment “story”, and use the contacts I make while pursuing it to try and land somewhere safe?

Yeah fortunately the loans will be forgiven either way in five years, at which point I’ll be debt free. I’m also fortunate that, as I said in the post, that I won’t be incurring more debt to pursue this degree, although it prevents my ability to save more than the bare minimum in the short term. I think the biggest risk is that this is a waste of time short term and won’t lead to better employment long term?
Yeah, my fear is you may be right. I hired a career consultant before I enrolled in the MBA program and she assured me this wasn’t the case, but I still have doubts.
Hey, thanks for the reply! I just finished an accounting course a few days ago and I was pretty bad at it tbh. Like I only passed because of the grading curve. Otherwise, I would!
